Syntax highlighting samples using the SyntaxHighlight extension.

== PHP ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="php" line>
<?php
namespace MediaWiki\Skins\NightSky;

use MediaWiki\Title\Title;

/**
 * Example class with docblock.
 */
final class Example extends Base implements \Countable {
	private const LIMIT = 42;
	private array $items = [];

	public function __construct( private string $name = 'nightsky' ) {}

	public function count(): int {
		// Single-line comment
		return count( $this->items ) + self::LIMIT; # hash comment
	}

	public function render( Title $title, ?string $extra = null ): string {
		$html = "<div class=\"box\">{$title->getPrefixedText()}</div>";
		foreach ( $this->items as $key => $value ) {
			if ( $value === null || !is_string( $key ) ) {
				continue;
			}
			$html .= sprintf( '%s=%d', $key, (int)$value * 3.14 );
		}
		return $html;
	}
}
</syntaxhighlight>

== JavaScript ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="javascript">
( function () {
	'use strict';
	const items = [ 1, 2, 3 ].map( ( n ) => n * 2 );
	async function load( url, opts = {} ) {
		/* block comment */
		const res = await fetch( url, { ...opts, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } } );
		if ( !res.ok ) { throw new Error( `HTTP ${ res.status }` ); }
		return res.json();
	}
	class Widget extends HTMLElement {
		static observed = [ 'label' ];
		get label() { return this.getAttribute( 'label' ) ?? 'none'; }
	}
	customElements.define( 'x-widget', Widget );
	console.log( /^[a-z]+$/i.test( 'NightSky' ), 0xFF, 1e3, null, undefined, true );
}() );
</syntaxhighlight>

== Lua ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="lua" line start="10">
local p = {}

-- build an infobox row
function p.row( label, data )
	if data == nil or mw.text.trim( data ) == '' then
		return ''
	end
	local html = mw.html.create( 'tr' )
	html:tag( 'th' ):addClass( 'infobox-label' ):wikitext( label )
	html:tag( 'td' ):addClass( 'infobox-data' ):wikitext( data )
	return tostring( html )
end

for i, v in ipairs( { 'a', 'b', 'c' } ) do
	print( i, v, #v, 3.5 * 2 )
end

return p
</syntaxhighlight>

== Python ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="python">
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Module docstring."""
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

@dataclass
class Row:
    label: str
    values: list[int] = field(default_factory=list)

    def total(self) -> int:
        return sum(v for v in self.values if v % 2 == 0)

def main(argv=None):
    pat = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>\w+)\s*=\s*(\d+)$")
    print(f"Total: {Row('x', [1,2,3,4]).total():>5}", end="\n")  # trailing comment
    return 0 if pat else 1

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
</syntaxhighlight>

== Bash ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
NAME="${1:-wiki}"   # default name
for f in skins/*/skin.json; do
  echo "Found: $f" | tee -a "log-$(date +%F).txt"
done
if [[ -d "$NAME" ]]; then cp -r "$NAME" "${NAME}.bak"; fi
</syntaxhighlight>

== SQL ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="sql">
-- recent edits
SELECT rc_title, COUNT(*) AS edits, MAX(rc_timestamp) AS last_edit
FROM recentchanges
WHERE rc_namespace = 0 AND rc_bot = 0
GROUP BY rc_title
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY edits DESC LIMIT 10;
</syntaxhighlight>

== C++ ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="cpp">
#include <iostream>
template <typename T>
class Stack {
  std::vector<T> data;
public:
  void push(const T& v) { data.push_back(v); }
  T pop() { T v = data.back(); data.pop_back(); return v; }
};
int main() { Stack<int> s; s.push(42); std::cout << s.pop() << '\n'; return 0; }
</syntaxhighlight>

== Plain text (no language) ==
<syntaxhighlight lang="text">
Just plain text, no tokens at all.
Nothing here should be invisible: identifiers, punctuation, numbers 12345.
</syntaxhighlight>

== Inline ==
Inline code such as <syntaxhighlight lang="php" inline>$x = array( 'a' => 1 );</syntaxhighlight> should also be readable, as should <code>plain code</code>, <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>S</kbd>, <samp>sample output</samp>, <tt>teletype</tt> and <var>variable</var>.
